title: Tiger cub in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- scarf back part -->
  <path d='M28 66 Q50 74 72 66 L74 74 Q50 82 26 74 Z' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#f39c12'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M40 68 Q42 76 40 84' stroke='#7a4a08' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 68 Q58 76 60 84' stroke='#7a4a08' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 92 Q50 84 50 76' stroke='#b06a10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf front wrap -->
  <path d='M30 62 Q50 72 70 62 L68 70 Q50 78 32 70 Z' fill='#ff6b5e'/>
  <path d='M32 70 L40 84 L30 86 Z' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='26' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='8' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='20' r='8' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='4' fill='#b06a10'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='20' r='4' fill='#b06a10'/>

  <path d='M50 18 L50 30' stroke='#7a4a08' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 20 L34 30' stroke='#7a4a08' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 20 L66 30' stroke='#7a4a08' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M24 40 L34 44' stroke='#7a4a08' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 40 L66 44' stroke='#7a4a08' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks/muzzle -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='50' r='7' fill='#fff6e5'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='50' r='7' fill='#fff6e5'/>
  <!-- muzzle bridge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#fff6e5'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='42' r='4.5' fill='#2c1810'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='42' r='4.5' fill='#2c1810'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='40.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='40.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M46 48 Q50 46 54 48 Q50 53 46 48 Z' fill='#e07b8a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 53 L50 57' stroke='#7a4a08' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 57 Q50 61 56 57' stroke='#7a4a08' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M30 50 L38 52' stroke='#b06a10' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 56 L38 55' stroke='#b06a10' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 50 L62 52' stroke='#b06a10' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 56 L62 55' stroke='#b06a10' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='92' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#fff6e5'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='92' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#fff6e5'/>
</svg>
